description: Verification and validation tracking for LMCache recipe library. Tracks testing status, hardware requirements, and notes for each recipe.

userStories.title: vLLM + LMCache (Storage Mode, single node) - CPU hot cache
userStories.notes: Single-node recipe. Can be validated on single GPU machine. Entry point for all users.

userStories.title: SGLang + LMCache (Storage Mode, single node)
userStories.notes: Single-node recipe. Requires SGLang installation. Similar to R-001 but for SGLang engine.

userStories.title: vLLM Production Stack + LMCache (enterprise deployment)
userStories.notes: Requires Kubernetes cluster. Marked as skipped - cannot validate without K8s infrastructure.

userStories.title: KServe runtime + LMCache
userStories.notes: Requires KServe on Kubernetes. Marked as skipped - cannot validate without K8s + KServe.

userStories.title: llm-d + LMCache
userStories.notes: Requires llm-d daemon on Kubernetes. Marked as skipped - cannot validate without K8s + llm-d.

userStories.title: CPU RAM backend (pinned memory)
userStories.notes: Covered in R-001. Core feature, can be validated on single node with sufficient CPU RAM.

userStories.title: Local disk backend (POSIX)
userStories.notes: Single-node recipe. Requires local NVMe/SSD storage. Can validate with local disk.

userStories.title: GDS backend (NVMe via GPUDirect Storage)
userStories.notes: Requires specific hardware: Ampere+ GPU and NVMe with GPUDirect support. Can validate on single node with compatible hardware.

userStories.title: NIXL as a storage backend (non-PD)
userStories.notes: Single-node recipe. Requires NIXL library installation. Can validate on single node.

userStories.title: Redis remote backend (single instance)
userStories.notes: Can validate on single node with Redis running locally or in Docker. Foundation for multi-instance recipes.

userStories.title: Redis Sentinel (HA)
userStories.notes: Requires Redis Sentinel setup (3+ nodes for quorum). Marked as skipped - needs multi-node Redis infrastructure.

userStories.title: Redis Cluster (sharded)
userStories.notes: Requires Redis Cluster (6+ nodes recommended). Marked as skipped - needs multi-node Redis infrastructure.

userStories.title: Valkey remote backend
userStories.notes: Similar to R-010. Can validate on single node with Valkey running locally or in Docker.

userStories.title: LMCache Server lm:// remote
userStories.notes: Single-node recipe. LMCache server runs as separate process on same node. No external dependencies.

userStories.title: S3 remote backend (cold tier)
userStories.notes: Requires S3 bucket (or MinIO). Can validate with local MinIO instance. Works on single node.

userStories.title: Mooncake remote backend
userStories.notes: Requires MooncakeStore cluster with RDMA. Marked as skipped - needs specialized hardware and multi-node setup.

userStories.title: InfiniStore remote backend
userStories.notes: Requires InfiniStore with RDMA. Marked as skipped - needs specialized hardware and multi-node setup.

userStories.title: Two vLLM instances share KV via remote store
userStories.notes: Requires multiple vLLM instances + load balancer. Marked as skipped - needs multi-instance setup on multiple nodes.

userStories.title: P2P KV sharing (controller-mediated, NIXL channel)
userStories.notes: Requires P2P setup with controller and NIXL. Marked as skipped - needs multi-node network configuration.

userStories.title: Controller-based routing + cache operations
userStories.notes: Requires controller + multiple workers. Marked as skipped - needs multi-instance orchestration.

userStories.title: PD on single node (vLLM v1 + NIXL)
userStories.notes: Single-node recipe. Requires multiple GPUs on same node for prefill/decode separation. Can validate on multi-GPU node.

userStories.title: PD across nodes (prefill pool → decode pool)
userStories.notes: Requires separate prefill and decode pools across nodes. Marked as skipped - needs multi-node GPU cluster.

userStories.title: PD tuning recipe: buffer device + buffer size
userStories.notes: Applies to both single-node and multi-node PD. Can validate tuning on single multi-GPU node.

userStories.title: Layerwise KV transfer
userStories.notes: Single-node optimization. Works with any backend. Can validate on single GPU. NEW: Created standalone recipe.

userStories.title: CacheGen compression (remote serde)
userStories.notes: Works on single node with remote backend. Can validate with local Redis or LMCache Server.

userStories.title: CacheBlend (non-prefix reuse) for RAG reorder
userStories.notes: Single-node feature. Can validate on single GPU with RAG use case.

userStories.title: Async loading optimization
userStories.notes: Single-node optimization. Can validate on single GPU with high concurrency.

userStories.title: Multiprocess mode
userStories.notes: Single-node feature. Can validate on single GPU. Uses separate storage process.

userStories.title: Single node perf tiering
userStories.notes: Single-node recipe. Combines CPU + disk. Can validate on single node with local storage.

userStories.title: Multi-node shared cache
userStories.notes: Requires multiple nodes with shared Redis. Marked as skipped - needs multi-node cluster.

userStories.title: Enterprise platform path
userStories.notes: Requires full Kubernetes stack. Marked as skipped - needs enterprise K8s infrastructure.

userStories.title: Ultimate separation path
userStories.notes: Requires multi-zone deployment with RDMA. Marked as skipped - needs large-scale infrastructure.

validationCriteria.yamlValidation: All YAML configs must pass syntax validation
